As competition in Egypt's digital market grows, Breadfast faces the challenge of strengthening awareness of its expanding services while maintaining one cohesive brand identity. The opportunity lies in moving beyond product-led communication to become a more relevant and engaging part of consumers' everyday lives. # BENCHMARKS ## TALABAT MART 411K FOLLOWERS 0.1% ENG RATE Talabat combines practical convenience messaging with promotions, fast delivery and a broad choice of shopping occasions. Its Egyptian website advertises groceries, food, flowers and medicine, while Talabat Mart highlights 15-minute delivery. Strong brand familiarity, cross-category reach, substantial logistics infrastructure and an established delivery ecosystem. Its April 2026 distribution hub covers approximately 27,000 m2 and supports its Mart network across 12 Egyptian cities. Content has a lot of big collaborations, social shows as sponsors, rather than just only a supermarket. What Breadfast can learn: Communicate convenience without making speed the entire story. Breadfast should connect its services to specific Egyptian needs and occasions while demonstrating its own product and brand advantages. ### RABBIT #### 73.4K FOLLOWERS 0.08% ENG RATE A fast, reliable shopping solution built around frequently needed groceries and household essentials. Its campaigns used newspaper-inspired layouts, large typography and recognizable lime-green branding to present a practical subscription benefit in an attention-grabbing way. Clear service proposition, distinctive brand identity and emphasis on practical customer benefits. Rabbit's app reports more than 1.4 million customers, 40 million items delivered and approximately 15-minute average delivery. These are company-reported figures. What Breadfast can learn: Give audiences additional emotional and lifestyle reasons to choose Breadfast. ### INSTASHOP #### 111K FOLLOWERS 0.2% ENG RATE A convenient digital marketplace connecting customers with supermarkets and other retailers. The central commercial proposition is access to stores, product variety and the convenience of ordering through one platform. This is a positioning-level assessment, not a measured analysis of its recent Instagram content. Content is heavily reliant on influencers collaborations, other than that the content is very still. Marketplace variety, familiar retail partners and a proposition that lets customers shop from multiple stores. What Breadfast can learn: Product availability alone is not enough for distinctive brand communication. Breadfast can potentially differentiate through original product storytelling, own-brand products, consistent content experiences and connected category discovery. ### NOON MINUTES #### 648K FOLLOWERS 0.5% ENG RATE Ultra-fast access to groceries, everyday essentials, personal care and other products through noon's commerce ecosystem.Its Egyptian launch focused on speed, product selection, value and Prime membership benefits. Unlike competitors that focus primarily on groceries, noon Minutes combines quick-commerce convenience with the resources of a larger digital retail platform. launched a big campaign lately with huge outdoors and copies and influencers collabs. What Breadfast can learn: Turn Convenience into an Experience: Go beyond speed and promotions by creating memorable, culturally relevant content and activations that drive engagement and product discovery. ### ESTIMATED ACTIVE USERS DURING Q4 2025 Noon Minutes isn’t included in this as this covers Q4 2025 # STRATEGIC IMPLICATIONSKeytakeaways Beauty deserves discovery-led, creator-led storytelling, rather than being presented as another supermarket category. Consumers have a growing set of online-shopping alternatives. Breadfast needs reasons to be chosen repeatedly, beyond app availability. Value needs to be demonstrated clearly: useful baskets, price comparisons, bundles and cost-conscious routines. Pay has an opportunity to make digital transactions feel familiar, useful, rewarding and trustworthy. Social content is a major discovery opportunity, but publishing volume alone won't translate into orders. # CURRENT SITUATION ## BREADAST SUPERMARKET ### 342K FOLLOWERS 0.2% ENG RATE Strong presence and recurring seasonal copies. Engagement rate can be improved, but it automatocally fluctuates based on current campaigns going on. #### What’s missing: Turn grocery content into useful inspiration Shift from products to people (in regular content anc series not just copes) Quick recipes and meal ideas using available grocery products Give the community a bigger role (Introduce creator-led shopping challenges, customer basket stories, street interviews and interactive content) ## BREADAST COFFEE ### 66.2K FOLLOWERS 1.8% ENG RATE Very strong engagement rate; recent copies are a big factor. Creator-led content (Karim Gabriel) and events and collaborations make the account more human and community-led. Its earlier Coffee Simplified series used baristas to educate consumers about brewing coffee at home. The brand has also explored experiential marketing through The List, an event concept connecting coffee, music and community. #### What’s missing: Stress on the everyday relatable coffee runs and situations Reintroduce or evolve barista-led education and establish weekly drink-focused series Introduce Coffee × Food pairings, breakfast occasions and relevant Supermarket products Feature customer orders, coffee preferences, creator collaborations and UGC ## BREADAST BEAUTY ### 5K FOLLOWERS 8.8% ENG RATE Extremely high engagement rate (recent campaign with Jala Hisham) Content looks fun but is mainly strictly AI-generated #### What’s missing: Creator reviews, GRWM, product testing, and realistic results Ingredient explainers, routine guides, product comparisons, and expert-led recommendations Self-care baskets, Beauty × Supermarket occasions and lifestyle collaborations Beauty dilemmas and customer favorites ## BREADAST FOOD ### 19.7K FOLLOWERS 0.2% ENG RATE Low engagement rate Content isn’t very dynamic; it looks neat but not engaging #### What’s missing: Prioritize food close-ups, preparation videos (Breadfast kitchen), and ASMR Relatable entertainment: Develop office lunch humor, late-night cravings, food debates, and relatable POVs Feature taste tests, UGC, restaurant challenges, and creator recommendations ### BREADAST PAY 1.6K FOLLOWERS 4.8% ENG RATE Really strong engagement rate at the start The biggest communication challenge is making these financial services easy to understand, trustworthy, and relevant to everyday Egyptian consumers. #### What’s missing: Simple feature explainers, FAQs, and step-by-step tutorials Introduce weekly educational and practical content series # TARGET AUDIENCE # GENERAL LOOK 16-55 (very wide age range that will be cleare in the personas) Middle to Affluent Greater Cairo, Alexandria, Mansoura Smartphone users familiar with digital shopping and delivery apps. Busy professionals, students, young couples and families. Value convenience, reliability, availability, and time-saving. Interested in deals, product recommendations, and relevant discoveries. Consume entertainment, lifestyle content, reviews, and trends on social media. ## AUDIENCE SEGMENTATION
Vertical Core Age Gender Focus Psychographic Profile
Supermarket 18-55 All; household shoppers Responsible, practical, budget-aware, organized, family-oriented
Beauty 16-40 Female-skewing Trend-conscious, experimental, appearance-aware, enjoys self-care
Coffee 16-35 All Social, routine-driven, productivity-focused, lifestyle-oriented
Food 16-55 All Spontaneous, craving-driven, convenience-seeking, experience-focused
Pay 21-55 All Practical, digitally comfortable, security-conscious, value-driven
## MALAK ### 17 YEARS OLD | NEW CAIRO | HIGH SCHOOL STUDENT | LIVES WITH FAMILY Personality: Social, spontaneous, curious, expressive and trend-conscious. Motivations: Discovering viral products, enjoying treats with friends and expressing her personality. Pain points: Limited allowance, dependence on parents for purchases and fear of missing out. Purchase triggers: TikTok trends, friend recommendations, affordable treats and new launches. Content interests: GRWM, viral snacks, food challenges, memes, unboxings and interactive content. Breadfast Usage: Beauty for trending products, Coffee for matcha and non-coffee drinks, Food for hangouts, and Supermarket for snacks and treats. Opportunity: Make Breadfast a go-to destination for Gen Z discoveries across multiple categories. ## SALMA ### 28 YEARS OLD · NEW CAIRO · SINGLE · HYBRID-WORKING PROFESSIONAL Personality: Independent, ambitious, socially active and convenience-driven. Motivations: Balancing a busy career, social plans and personal routines without wasting time. Pain points: Decision fatigue, limited free time, forgotten essentials and juggling different apps. Purchase triggers: Busy workdays, spontaneous plans, morning routines and last-minute needs. Content interests: Day-in-the-life Reels, work humor, lifestyle hacks, beauty routines and recommendations. Breadfast Usage: Coffee for work mornings, Food for office lunches, Beauty for self-care, Supermarket for home essentials, and Pay for eligible everyday purchases. Opportunity: Position Breadfast as the all-in-one companion that makes her busy lifestyle easier. ## AHMED & NOUR ### 32 AND 30 YEARS OLD · 6TH OF OCTOBER · MARRIED · BOTH EMPLOYED Personality: Practical, social, collaborative and experience-oriented. Motivations: Spending quality time together while managing shared expenses and household needs. Pain points: Different preferences, limited time after work, repetitive meals and balancing spending with enjoyment. Purchase triggers: Date nights, weekend plans, hosting friends, grocery restocks and cashback opportunities. Content interests: Dinner inspiration, weekend activities, shared shopping and spending tips. Breadfast Usage: Supermarket for household shopping, Food for date nights, Coffee for weekend treats, Beauty for personal care and gifting, and Pay for eligible purchases and rewards. Opportunity: Present Breadfast as a shared lifestyle solution that makes everyday responsibilities and enjoyable moments easier. ## MARIAM 38 YEARS OLD · NEW CAIRO · MARRIED WITH TWO CHILDREN · WORKING MOTHER Personality: Organized, responsible, caring, practical and value-conscious. Motivations: Keeping her family comfortable while managing time, household expenses and personal needs. Pain points: Endless shopping lists, unexpected family needs, rising expenses and limited personal time. Purchase triggers: Weekly restocks, school needs, family gatherings, convenient meal solutions and relevant offers. Content interests: Smart baskets, price comparisons, recipes, household hacks and offers, Practical tips & Self-care. Breadfast Usage: Supermarket for family essentials, Food for busy evenings, Coffee for daily breaks, Beauty for personal care and Pay for eligible spending benefits. Opportunity: Show how Breadfast simplifies family responsibilities while leaving more time for herself. ## HANY ### 52 YEARS OLD | HELIOPOLIS | MARRIED | BUSINESS OWNER Personality: Confident, financially savvy, family-oriented, practical and quality-conscious. Motivations: Enjoying convenience, getting more value from purchases and spending wisely without compromising his lifestyle. Pain Points: Carrying cash, managing multiple payment methods, unnecessary errands and missing out on spending rewards. Purchase Triggers: Cashback on eligible purchases, straightforward card benefits, trusted services, convenience and quality. Content Interests: Financial tips, spending hacks, cashback benefits, food recommendations and lifestyle content. Breadfast Usage: Pay for everyday card spending, Supermarket for household purchases, Coffee for daily outings, Food for family meals and Beauty for gifts and personal care. Opportunity: Position Breadfast as a convenient, rewarding everyday ecosystem—not just a grocery platform or payment card. # KEY TAKEAWAYS Personas Analysis
One Consumer, Multiple Needs Convenience Is the Common Ground Value Goes Beyond Price
Different Audiences Require Different Communication Everyday Moments Drive Relevance Trust Encourages Trial
Discovery Is the Gateway to Cross-Vertical Growth
## DIFFERENT LIFESTYLES. SHARED EVERYDAY NEEDS. ONE CONNECTED ECOSYSTEM. Breadfast's opportunity lies in understanding the moments that connect its diverse audiences and transforming individual category awareness into broader everyday relevance. By delivering personalized, relatable, and useful content, Breadfast can encourage discovery, strengthen consideration, and build lasting customer relationships. STRATEGY umbrella for the 5 accounts LIFE IS COMPLICATED ENOUGH # BETWEEN WORK, ERRANDS, RESPONSIBILITIES, AND PERSONAL NEEDS OUR DAYS ARE ALREADY PACKED WITH THINGS TO GET DONE # YET SOMEHOW, WE KEEP MAKING IT HARDER # WE STICK TO FAMILIAR HABITS, TAKE UNNECESSARY TRIPS, AND COMPLICATE SIMPLE TASKS WITHOUT EVEN REALIZING IT # UNTIL WE DISCOVER THERE'S AN EASIER WAY # SOMETIMES, ONE SIMPLE DISCOVERY CHANGES HOW WE APPROACH SOMETHING WE'VE BEEN DOING THE SAME WAY FOR YEARS # AND SUDDENLY, THE OLD WAY MAKES NO SENSE # WHAT IF THE EASIER WAY WAS ALREADY THERE? # WITH GROCERIES, BEAUTY, COFFEE, FOOD, AND PAY BREADFAST OFFERS MORE WAYS TO SIMPLIFY EVERYDAY LIFE THAN CONSUMERS MIGHT REALIZE ةشيعلا را حاتت WHEN EVERYDAY GETS EASIER, LIFE GETS BETTER. # This umbrella allows each account to represents a different way Breadfast can make life feel easier. Supermarket: Less hassle managing household essentials Beauty: More convenient access to beauty and personal care Coffee: Enjoying your coffee without interrupting your routine Food: Less time figuring out meals, more time enjoying them Pay: more convenient payment experiences through verified features # LANGUAGE & TONE Bilingual Supermarket: Warm, witty, practical, price-smart Beauty: Confident, playful, trendy, insider Coffee: Cozy, cheeky, casual, expressive Food: Bold, appetizing, fun, tempting Pay: Simple, reassuring, informative, rewarding # MAIN PLATFORMS # CONTENT PILLARS 1-Everyday Made Easy This is our most commercially driven pillar. Instead of simply showcasing products, we’ll communicate their value through relevant situations, useful combinations, and recognizable consumer needs. 2-EVERYDAY, THE Breadfast WAY This pillar focuses on the situations, habits, conversations, and humor that make everyday Egyptian life recognizable. We’ll use trends as creative opportunities rather than simply following them. 3- LITTLE LIFE HACKS 3-Little Life Hacks This pillar gives consumers a reason to save and return to Breadfast’s content, even when they’re not immediately planning to purchase. CONTENT PILLARS 4- REAL LIFE, REAL PEOPLE Strengthen trust, authenticity, and emotional connection through real consumer experiences and creator-led storytelling. Rather than having Breadfast do all the talking, this pillar gives consumers and creators a voice. 5- BETTER TOGETHER This is the pillar that brings the five pages together. Rather than forcing all accounts to publish identical content, we’ll connect them through shared moments, relevant occasions, and complementary needs. ## GENERAL CONTENT SERIES ### ةشيعلا راتحات 1- POV: Short, relatable POV videos and statics capturing the little everyday moments when people realize they can stop overcomplicating things and relax with breadfast (even if anything else is going wrong) تصلخ ،كلغش اشعلا ،زهاج ةوهقلا يف ،كديإ شمو جاتحم لزنت Sample Content: "POV: ." يرتشت ةجاح #### 2- Day in a life of (a persona) A relatable storytelling series following different Egyptian personalities through their daily routines, highlighting how Breadfast naturally fits into their lifestyles. Each episode showcases multiple services through familiar situations, connecting convenience with real consumer needs. ## LET’S SEE HOW IT WILL BE EXECUTED ACROSS THE 5 ACCOUNTS ## 1-BREADFAST SUPERMARKET Our content will revolve around the reality of Egyptian households: the never-ending grocery lists, forgotten essentials, unexpected guests, family food preferences, and the daily challenge of managing household needs. We’ll combine relatable Egyptian humor, practical shopping solutions, product storytelling, and real consumer experiences to make supermarket content both entertaining and commercially relevant. CONTENT DIRECTION ## 01. EVERYDAY MADE EASY | Product & Price — 30% - Animated Price-Hero Reels: Fast-paced product animations highlighting offers, prices, and everyday essentials through bold typography and dynamic transitions. - Curated Basket Carousels: Swipeable product collections organized around specific budgets, household sizes, or shopping occasions, with a complete basket revealed on the final slide. - Product Spotlight Statics: Clean, product-first visuals introducing new arrivals, exclusive brands, and frequently purchased essentials. ## 02. EVERYDAY, THE BREADFAST WAY| CULTURE & TRENDS — 25% - Trending Audio Reels: Adapt relevant Egyptian TikTok sounds and memes to familiar supermarket situations. - Meme-Style Statics: Simple, humorous visuals built around recognizable shopping behaviors. ## 03. LITTLE LIFE HACKS | Usefulness — 20% - Recipe Reels: Quick overhead cooking videos demonstrating simple meals made with Breadfast ingredients. - Step-by-Step Carousels: Save-worthy guides covering meal preparation, shopping organization, and ingredient substitutions. ### CONTENT DIRECTION ## 04. REAL LIFE, REAL PEOPLE | Community & ### Creators — 15% - Street Interview Reels: Asking Egyptian consumers about their shopping habits, essential products, and household preferences. - Creator-Led Basket Videos: Lifestyle and food creators sharing what they regularly order. - Shopping Challenges: Interactive videos where participants build baskets within a specific budget or for a particular occasion. ## 05. BETTER TOGETHER | Brand & Campaigns — 10% - Lifestyle Reels: Showcasing complete occasions that combine Supermarket with Food, Coffee, or other relevant verticals. - Collaborative Carousels: Product combinations involving multiple Breadfast categories. ### SUPERMARKET MOODBOARD ·iiev?I,, g 4êi Ĩ "G Sl': [ Hcữne Q«= LEFT -- - -, YOUR 12.12 FAVOURITES WONT WAIT! HURRY UP GIRLES ¥M theskinfit H b• ertsn% #### 2-BREADFAST COFFEE We want to build a recognizable coffee culture around moods, routines, personalities, conversations, and small daily pleasures. The content should be warm, visually appealing, and relatable, while giving people reasons to discover new drinks and return to their favorites. ### CONTENT DIRECTION #### 01. EVERYDAY MADE EASY | Product & Price — 30% - Coffee ASMR Reels - Product Hero Videos: Cinematic drink reveals featuring menu favorites, new flavors, and seasonal launches. - Menu Carousels: Visual drink guides highlighting different options and flavor profiles. #### 02. EVERYDAY, THE BREADFAST WAY | CULTURE & TRENDS — 25% - Relatable coffee situations inspired by office workers, students, and everyday routines. - Trending Audio Videos: Coffee-related interpretations of popular social trends. - Coffee Personality Posts: Entertaining content matching drinks with moods and personalities. #### 03. LITTLE LIFE HACKS | Usefulness — 20% - Behind-the-Bar Videos: Showing how different drinks are prepared. - Educational Carousels: Simple visual guides helping audiences understand the menu. CONTENT DIRECTION #### 04. REAL LIFE, REAL PEOPLE | Community & Creators — 15% - Conversation Reels: Casual interviews with creators and customers over Breadfast coffee. - Barista-Led Videos: Featuring preparation techniques, personal recommendations, and behind-the-scenes moments. #### 05. BETTER TOGETHER | Brand & Campaigns — 10% - Food Pairing posts: Visually appealing combinations of Breadfast Coffee with Food or Supermarket products. - Lifestyle Videos: Coffee as part of a connected workday, study session, or weekend routine.
